Senior Backend Engineer

Northwind Payments · Remote (US) · Full-time

About the role

You will own the settlement and payouts platform: the services that move money reliably at scale. We care about correctness, latency, and clean operational stories.

What you'll do

  • Design and operate high-throughput payment services in Go.
  • Drive down p99 latency and improve reliability of the settlement pipeline.
  • Partner with product and risk teams to ship safely.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years building backend services; strong in Go or a similar systems language.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Kafka, and AWS.
  • A track record of improving reliability in production.

We offer competitive compensation and a remote-first culture.
